Passed on the fake backend only (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored by deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017 (run wD-017) and unreviewed: reviewed_by is null and no hardware or Gazebo run was made. The card's GymnasiumDriver family expresses the registered gymfc_nf-step-v1 environment (examples/gymfc_nf/envs/__init__.py:6-14), whose native StepEnv uses the legacy gym interface; the bridge accepts its reset() and four-tuple step(). The upstream simulator needs Gazebo 10.1.0 with Dart 6.7.0, the C++ plugins built by setup.py:9-32, a digital-twin SDF and a UDP protobuf channel (README.md:97, gymfc/envs/fc_env.py:168-172, :488-493); none is available to the gate, so fake.py is the package's pure Python stand-in and was not compared with the upstream simulator. The sim backend (installed GymFC plus Gazebo) was not run. The fake reproduces the registered spaces (four-element Box action space [-1,1], unbounded six-element observation Box), the [0,1] action clipping of examples/gymfc_nf/envs/base.py:79, the six-element state of examples/gymfc_nf/envs/states.py:19-21, the 4.608 s episode at 0.001 s steps and the reward terms of examples/gymfc_nf/envs/rewards.py:33-88; its motor mixer and first-order rate response are placeholders, not the Gazebo/Dart dynamics, and the fidelity gaps say so, together with the missing actuator/sensor/noise models, UDP channel, wall-clock pacing and snapshot support. Only catalogue classes are used (cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.seed.v1), so there are no catalogue_requests. There are no operator_required limits: the only bound is the environment's own action space, which the bridge derives and reports as upstream_code. Expected warnings, not cleared: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (the seed only sets the seed of the next reset and makes no native call) and four G8.NO_UNIT warnings for the bridge-derived integer/array inputs (ticks, seed twice, action.values); the bridge owns the step schema, so a driver-declared action cannot add units without changing that schema. No G4 warning remains. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest line the last check printed.
